snippet.title: 1000: The All-Mother's Embrace (Trailer 1)
snippet.description:
This is my new game. I've been working on it for the past couple years - there's still a lot to do before I can release it, so in the meantime be sure to add it to wishlist!
Story - Nikita Kryukov
Music - Nikita Kryukov, Pazetic_Ocean
Visuals - VeoWind, dethmaid, EccoMicco
Editing - kurjategija (thanatochaos)
